value.rationale: The first nonouter Euclidean vertex radius is the natural spectral clearance below the circumsphere. Its closed value detects the shortest chain length independently of cyclic order and other lengths, and its complete multiplicity additionally determines how many shortest chains occur. The sharp collision between 2m(s-1) and ms across the half-size boundary describes a natural metric-combinatorial degeneration of an infinite polytope family; the elementary outer-sphere bound alone is not presented as the contribution.
